title: Tender: hook-path fix + per-spoke integrity verification
description: Fix the silent hook failure plague ($CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in all spoke settings.json hook paths — CC never resolves this var, so UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/Stop/PreCompact silently never fire). Add post-tend verification that confirms each spoke is on current framework_version and has no open implementation lugs. Expose --spoke flag for targeted single-spoke runs with live progress logging.

perceive.current_state: templates/spoke/.claude/settings.json uses $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in all 5 hook commands. merge_settings() in run_nightly.py copies these verbatim. check_cc_hooks() resolves the var before checking file existence so always PASSES. Result: 16/17 spokes have broken hooks that never fire. Hub just fixed manually.
evidence: spoke_health_check.py:420 does cmd.replace('$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR', str(project_root)) before checking existence — validation gap
run_nightly.py merge_settings() lines ~85: copies hook entries from template without substituting the placeholder

steps: 1. Add env-var detection to check_cc_hooks() — FAIL before resolving if $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR present
2. Fix merge_settings() — deepcopy entries and replace $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR with spoke_path before writing
3. Add env-var remediation handler in remediate_spoke() router — sed-replace in settings.json
4. Add verify_spoke_current() fn — checks framework_version, hook cleanliness, open impl lugs
5. Add --- Post-Tend Verification --- log section per spoke
6. Add progress log file (LOGS_DIR/fleet-progress-{date}.log) with live [N/17] timing output
7. Add --spoke CLI flag to main() for targeted single-spoke runs
8. Fix SessionStart template path from WAI-Spoke/_hooks/ to .claude/hooks/
9. Run fleet — all 17 spokes, pilot 3 first then remaining 14

done_when: python3 tools/spoke_health_check.py /home/mario/projects/minder --quick returns PASS on all hooks-* checks
All 17 spoke logs contain '--- Post-Tend Verification ---' with 'Hook paths: clean'

acceptance_criteria: Fleet has zero spokes with $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in hook paths
Health check correctly detects env-var paths as FAIL (not PASS)
merge_settings() writes absolute paths for all new/remediated hook entries
Per-spoke log shows framework_version, hook cleanliness, open impl lugs after each tend run
--spoke flag allows targeted single-spoke run without processing full fleet
behavior_specification: When Tender remediates any spoke, hook commands in settings.json always use absolute paths. When health check runs, $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in hook commands is a FAIL not a PASS.
test_requirements: Run spoke_health_check.py on a spoke with $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR paths — must return FAIL. Run run_nightly.py --spoke on that spoke — must fix the paths. Re-run health check — must return PASS.
resolution: Completed in S116. Code was already implemented. Fleet run at 16:54 fixed 14/17 spokes. All 17 GREEN with clean hook paths. Zero $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR remaining.
